question: 2025年一共有多少笔订单被取消了？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trade_order WHERE order_status = 'cancelled' AND order_time >= '2025-01-01' AND order_time < '2026-01-01'

question: 常住地在浙江的用户有多少人？

question: 2025年6月的GMV是多少？
evidence: GMV = 已支付过的订单（pay_time 不为空，含后续退款）的明细金额之和，按下单时间统计
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.item_amount) AS gmv FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_time >= '2025-06-01' AND o.order_time < '2025-07-01'
alt_sqls: SELECT SUM(gmv) FROM ads_trade_gmv_daily WHERE stat_date BETWEEN '2025-06-01' AND '2025-06-30'
SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM trade_order WHERE pay_time IS NOT NULL AND order_time >= '2025-06-01' AND order_time < '2025-07-01'
SELECT gmv FROM ads_trade_gmv_monthly WHERE stat_month = '2025-06'

question: 2025年各个一级品类的销售额分别是多少？按销售额从高到低排
evidence: 销售额 = 已支付订单的明细金额之和
gold_sql: SELECT c1.category_name, SUM(i.item_amount) AS sales FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN item_sku s ON s.sku_id = i.sku_id JOIN item_category c2 ON c2.category_id = s.category_id JOIN item_category c1 ON c1.category_id = c2.parent_id WHERE o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_time >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_time < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c1.category_name ORDER BY sales DESC
alt_sqls: SELECT category1_name, SUM(item_amount) AS sales FROM dwd_trade_order_detail_di WHERE is_paid = 1 AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY category1_name ORDER BY sales DESC
SELECT category1_name, SUM(sales_amount) AS sales FROM ads_trade_cate1_sales_monthly WHERE stat_month BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY category1_name ORDER BY sales DESC

question: 2025年的客单价是多少？
evidence: 客单价 = 已支付订单的实付金额之和 / 已支付订单数，保留两位小数
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(pay_amount) / COUNT(*), 2) AS aov FROM trade_order WHERE pay_time IS NOT NULL AND order_time >= '2025-01-01' AND order_time < '2026-01-01'

question: 2025年买过手机的用户里，各会员等级分别有多少人？
evidence: 买过 = 有已支付订单；手机为二级品类
gold_sql: SELECT u.member_level, COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS user_cnt FROM user_info u JOIN trade_order o ON o.buyer_id = u.user_id JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN item_sku s ON s.sku_id = i.sku_id JOIN item_category c ON c.category_id = s.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '手机' AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_time >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_time < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY u.member_level ORDER BY u.member_level
alt_sqls: SELECT member_level, COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_id) AS user_cnt FROM dwd_trade_order_detail_di WHERE category2_name = '手机' AND is_paid = 1 AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY member_level ORDER BY member_level

question: 2025年12月每天的下单量
gold_sql: SELECT DATE(order_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trade_order WHERE order_time >= '2025-12-01' AND order_time < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE(order_time) ORDER BY d

question: 2025年的复购率是多少？
evidence: 复购率 = 已支付订单数 ≥ 2 的用户数 / 已支付订单数 ≥ 1 的用户数 × 100，保留两位小数
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cnt >= 2) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS repurchase_rate FROM (SELECT buyer_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trade_order WHERE pay_time IS NOT NULL AND order_time >= '2025-01-01' AND order_time < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY buyer_id) t
alt_sqls: SELECT ROUND(repurchase_rate * 100, 2) FROM ads_user_repurchase_yearly WHERE stat_year = 2025

evidence: 客单价 = 已支付订单实付金额之和 / 已支付订单数；90后 = 1990～1999年出生

question: S级品牌的商品在2025年一共卖了多少钱？
evidence: 销售额 = 已支付订单的明细金额之和
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.item_amount) FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN item_sku s ON s.sku_id = i.sku_id JOIN item_brand b ON b.brand_name = s.brand_name WHERE b.brand_level = 'S' AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_time >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_time < '2026-01-01'
alt_sqls: SELECT SUM(o.item_amount) FROM dwd_trade_order_detail_di o JOIN dim_sku d ON d.sku_id = o.sku_id WHERE d.brand_level = 'S' AND o.is_paid = 1 AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
SELECT SUM(o.paid_amount) FROM dws_trade_brand_order_1m o JOIN item_brand b ON b.brand_name = o.brand_name WHERE b.brand_level = 'S' AND o.stat_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

question: 来自日本的品牌一共有多少个在售商品？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_sku s JOIN item_brand b ON b.brand_name = s.brand_name WHERE b.origin_country = '日本' AND s.sku_status = 'on_sale'
alt_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_sku d JOIN item_brand b ON b.brand_id = d.brand_id WHERE b.origin_country = '日本' AND d.sku_status = 'on_sale'

question: 2025年销售额最高的二级品类是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(i.item_amount) AS amt FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN item_sku s ON s.sku_id = i.sku_id JOIN item_category c ON c.category_id = s.category_id WHERE o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_time >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_time < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY amt DESC, c.category_name LIMIT 1
alt_sqls: SELECT category2_name, SUM(item_amount) AS amt FROM dwd_trade_order_detail_di WHERE is_paid = 1 AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY category2_name ORDER BY amt DESC, category2_name LIMIT 1

question: 2025年每个会员等级贡献了多少GMV？
evidence: GMV = 已支付订单的明细金额之和
gold_sql: SELECT u.member_level, SUM(i.item_amount) FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id = o.buyer_id WHERE o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_time >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_time < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY u.member_level ORDER BY u.member_level
alt_sqls: SELECT member_level, SUM(IF(is_paid = 1, item_amount, 0)) FROM dwd_trade_order_detail_di WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY member_level ORDER BY member_level
SELECT member_level, SUM(paid_amount) FROM dws_trade_level_order_1m WHERE stat_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY member_level ORDER BY member_level

question: 2025年第二季度的GMV是多少？
evidence: GMV = 已支付订单的明细金额之和，按下单时间
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.item_amount) FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_time >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_time < '2025-07-01'
alt_sqls: SELECT SUM(gmv) FROM ads_trade_gmv_monthly WHERE stat_month IN ('2025-04', '2025-05', '2025-06')
SELECT SUM(gmv) FROM ads_trade_gmv_daily WHERE stat_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30'
SELECT SUM(item_amount) FROM dwd_trade_order_detail_di WHERE is_paid = 1 AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30'

question: 2025年上半年每个月有多少笔支付订单？
evidence: 按下单月份统计
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m') AS m, COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE pay_time IS NOT NULL AND order_time >= '2025-01-01' AND order_time < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY m ORDER BY m
alt_sqls: SELECT stat_month, paid_order_cnt FROM ads_trade_gmv_monthly WHERE stat_month BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-06' ORDER BY stat_month

question: 2025年国庆假期（10月1日到7日）一共有多少订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE order_time >= '2025-10-01' AND order_time < '2025-10-08'

question: 2025年周末下的订单占全年订单的百分比是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(DAYOFWEEK(order_time) IN (1, 7)) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) FROM trade_order WHERE order_time >= '2025-01-01' AND order_time < '2026-01-01'
alt_sqls: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(stat_date) IN (1, 7) THEN order_cnt ELSE 0 END) / SUM(order_cnt) * 100, 2) FROM dws_trade_user_order_1d WHERE stat_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

question: 2025年新注册用户贡献了多少GMV？
evidence: GMV = 已支付订单的明细金额之和
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.item_amount) FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id = o.buyer_id WHERE o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_time >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_time < '2026-01-01' AND u.register_time >= '2025-01-01' AND u.register_time < '2026-01-01'

SELECT SUM(o.item_amount) FROM dwd_trade_order_detail_di o JOIN dim_user u ON u.user_id = o.buyer_id WHERE o.is_paid = 1 AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND u.register_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

question: 2025年12月的GMV比11月增长了百分之多少？
evidence: 环比增长率 = (本月GMV - 上月GMV) / 上月GMV × 100，保留两位小数
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((d.v - n.v) / n.v * 100, 2) FROM (SELECT SUM(i.item_amount) AS v FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_time >= '2025-12-01' AND o.order_time < '2026-01-01') d, (SELECT SUM(i.item_amount) AS v FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_time >= '2025-11-01' AND o.order_time < '2025-12-01') n
alt_sqls: SELECT ROUND((d.gmv - n.gmv) / n.gmv * 100, 2) FROM ads_trade_gmv_monthly d, ads_trade_gmv_monthly n WHERE d.stat_month = '2025-12' AND n.stat_month = '2025-11'

question: 2025年销售额排名前5的收货省份是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT o.receiver_province, SUM(i.item_amount) AS amt FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_time >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_time < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.receiver_province ORDER BY amt DESC, o.receiver_province LIMIT 5
alt_sqls: SELECT receiver_province, SUM(sales_amount) AS amt FROM ads_trade_province_sales_monthly WHERE stat_month BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY receiver_province ORDER BY amt DESC, receiver_province LIMIT 5

question: 2025年各会员等级的复购率分别是多少？
evidence: 复购率 = 已支付订单数 ≥ 2 的用户数 / 已支付订单数 ≥ 1 的用户数 × 100，保留两位小数
gold_sql: SELECT t.member_level, ROUND(SUM(t.cnt >= 2) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) FROM (SELECT u.member_level, o.buyer_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trade_order o JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id = o.buyer_id WHERE o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_time >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_time < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY u.member_level, o.buyer_id) t GROUP BY t.member_level ORDER BY t.member_level
alt_sqls: SELECT z.member_level, ROUND(SUM(t.cnt >= 2) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) FROM (SELECT buyer_id, SUM(paid_order_cnt) AS cnt FROM dws_trade_user_order_1d WHERE stat_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY buyer_id HAVING cnt > 0) t JOIN dim_user_zip z ON z.user_id = t.buyer_id AND z.end_date = '9999-12-31' GROUP BY z.member_level ORDER BY z.member_level

SELECT z.member_level, ROUND(SUM(t.cnt >= 2) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) FROM (SELECT buyer_id, SUM(pay_cnt) AS cnt FROM dws_trade_user_pay_1m WHERE stat_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY buyer_id HAVING cnt > 0) t JOIN dim_user_zip z ON z.user_id = t.buyer_id AND z.end_date = '9999-12-31' GROUP BY z.member_level ORDER BY z.member_level
